entities.name: Inspirit
entities.description: A legendary fabled eternity ship adrift in the Garden of Apeiron, home to mechans and guided by its self-aware mind Kilo.

entities.name: Kilo
entities.description: Self-aware artificial mind of the Inspirit.

entities.name: Garden of Apeiron
entities.description: Vast uncanny region at the edge of the system where the Inspirit drifts.

entities.name: Mechans
entities.description: Legion of mechans aboard the Inspirit seeking self-actualization.

events.summary: The Inspirit was launched and lost to the hazards of Weft travel and now drifts in the Garden of Apeiron.
events.quote: launched and lost to the hazards of Weft travel

relations.quote: the ship lives through its self-aware artificial mind, Kilo
